question: Where’s the closest hotel forward of Popcorn Park Animal Refuge, Forked River, NJ in the direction of Salus University, Elkins Park, PA?
sql: WITH popcorn_park_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Popcorn Park Animal Refuge%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), salus_university_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Salus University%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), reference_points AS ( SELECT pp.geometry AS popcorn_park_geom, su.geometry AS salus_university_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(pp.geometry, su.geometry)) AS target_bearing_degrees FROM popcorn_park_location pp, salus_university_location su ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, reference_points rp WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND p.geometry IS NOT NULL -- Filter by direction: hotel's bearing from popcorn park should be within +/- 45 degrees of the target bearing AND ( SELECT LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(rp.popcorn_park_geom, p.geometry)) - rp.target_bearing_degrees), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(rp.popcorn_park_geom, p.geometry)) - rp.target_bearing_degrees) ) ) <= 45 -- Angle tolerance of 45 degrees -- Ensure the hotel is not at the exact same location as Popcorn Park AND ST_Distance(rp.popcorn_park_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) > 0 ORDER BY ST_Distance(rp.popcorn_park_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
